meaning: Normalized target row index; WT_ALT/PrimeDesign drop custom IDs. Keep the external mutation lookup.
Full unedited context supplied or obtained from the reference genome.
Full context with the intended edit only; added silent bystanders are not included here.
Normalized edit category, e.g. SNP, DEL, INS, ONP. This fixture has those four categories.
Reference allele at the intended edit, excluding shared flanking context.
Alternate allele at the intended edit, excluding shared flanking context.
Shared context before the normalized intended edit.
Shared context after the normalized intended edit.
For + PAM use [PAM_start,PAM_end); for - PAM endpoints descend and forward interval is [PAM_end,PAM_start). Not genomic coordinates.
Other boundary of the PAM in wt_w_context; see PAM_start for strand-dependent convention.
Actual matched PAM sequence, e.g. TGG, rather than the search pattern NGG.
PAM orientation relative to the forward input sequence.
Native sequence: 4 nt upstream flank + 20 nt target + 3 nt PAM + 3 nt downstream flank. Native target is [4:24].
Synthesized spacer forced to uppercase G + 19 native bases. May differ from native target20; OptiPrime mismatch-feature semantics need review.
Reverse transcription template including the intended edit and any added bystanders. Reverse complement gives the corresponding edited target strand.
Length of RTT.
Primer binding sequence complementary to the corresponding target strand.
Length of PBS.
Concatenation RTT followed by PBS; the pegRNA extension.
Distance from nick boundary to the start of the intended edit in PAM-oriented context.
Right homology arm after the edited allele in the RTT.
OR of PAM_disrupted_edit and PAM_disrupted_by_bystander.
Positional indicator Distance_to_nick < 3; not a general recomputation of spacer mismatches after all bystanders.
Whether the generated candidate contains extra synonymous changes under the supplied coding-frame assumptions. Not exercised in this fixture.
Number of additional bystander base changes. Zero for the fixture with silent_bystander=False.
Positions of additional base changes in reverse-complement(RTT), not in the stored RTT or genome. Empty without bystanders.

Minimum distance from a bystander base to intended-edit anchor endpoints. Inserted/replaced ALT interval anchors nondeletions; two bases around the deletion junction anchor deletions. Empty without bystanders.
Whether the intended-edit-only allele disrupts the PAM pattern.
Additional PAM loss caused by bystanders when the intended edit itself preserves the PAM.
Doench 2016 Cas9 activity prediction from native30; not prime-editing efficiency. N-containing inputs return -1; unsupported length can be missing.
Fraction G or C in the actual PBS; not percent.
Fraction G or C in the actual candidate RTT, including any bystanders; not percent.
Absolute difference between REF and ALT lengths; zero for equal-length substitutions.
Fixed weighted sum of 10 features with no intercept or clipping; higher ranks first. Not a probability. Missing Azimuth is filled with zero during scoring.
RF_PE.pkl prediction on the same 10 features. Calling code alone does not establish calibrated units. Missing Azimuth is filled with zero during scoring.
Descending order by rankby, default PEGG2_Score, among candidates remaining before final output limits.
Separate rank for plain versus bystander-bearing designs if enabled; otherwise equals pegRNA_rank.
Cropped unedited sensor sequence in sensor_orientation. Missing on reported sensor construction errors.
Cropped edited sensor sequence in sensor_orientation; intended to include candidate-specific bystanders. Missing on reported construction errors.
Requested orientation of the sensor construct; reverse-complement in this run. Distinct from PAM_strand.
No Error or an explicit placement/context/length error. Four fixture rows report sensor too small; guide generation still succeeded.
observed_example: sensor too small; increase sensor size in parameters; or decrease before_proto_context
